neighbours.label: a stance/contrast adverb placed mid-clause after the subject or verb: 'I, however,', 'there is in fact', 'we are now'
fire: My brother, however, has never enjoyed long drives in the countryside.
Studies now suggest that there is in fact a link between sleep and memory.
I do, however, have a few concerns about the new schedule.
The old mill is in fact still working after two hundred years.
The museum, however, remains closed to visitors on Mondays.
She was in fact the first woman to captain the national team.
We, however, decided to stay home and finish the painting.
The rumour turned out to be in fact entirely true.
